title: 第5章 纯度九成二？你在糊弄谁！
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
接下来几天陈青山闷头处理废渣，白天分拣，晚上偷炼，日子过得充实。

    柳青霜来废器处理组已经三天了，这女人一来就把组里的规矩重新理了一遍，谁负责什么，每天交多少精铁，全部白纸黑字写得清清楚楚，其他杂役私底下抱怨，但没人敢当面说。

    陈青山更不在乎，他关心的是另一件事，废渣堆里的东西够他吃很久。

    器峰的废渣和废器房不一样，废器房的废渣大多是一般废料的残渣，杂质有限，器峰的废渣里头什么都有，碎矿渣、炉底结块、炸裂的坩埚碎片，甚至还混杂着一些被灵气浸染的碎石，正常熔炼出铁率不到四成，没人愿意碰。

    但造化鼎不挑。

    就这样，陈青山开始了他的偷偷修炼之路。

    这天夜里，陈青山关好屋门，偷偷地从废渣堆里暗中收来一块黑褐色废渣，足有拳头大小，杂质极多，正常提炼十斤这种废渣能出三斤精铁就算不错了，他心念一动，废渣投入造化鼎，鼎内火焰升腾，废渣开始融化，杂质一层层剥离，三个时辰后，一块银白色精铁从鼎中飞出，陈青山掂了掂，二两多。

    十斤废渣出二两精铁，搁正常手法这就是赔本买卖，但他要的不是量，是纯度。

    这块精铁的纯度比平时提炼的还要高一截，因为这块废渣里头混了少量火毒残余，造化鼎把火毒也吃了，转化成了更猛的火焰，等于白赚一波燃料。

    “火毒真是好东西……”

    他低声嘟囔了一句，又投入第二块，一整夜，十五块废渣全部处理完，得了七斤精铁，然后他挑出其中品相最好的两斤二次提纯，二次提纯消耗灵力更大，他一边运转功法恢复，一边供给造化鼎，勉强撑到天亮，两斤精铁变成了四两铁精，他没停，继续第三次提纯，这次用了两天，四两铁精变成了七钱铁元晶。

    米粒大小的晶体散发着刺眼的银光，蕴含的元气精华比上次在废器房提炼的浓了不止一倍。

    陈青山拿起一粒铁元晶开始吸收，炽热的元气涌入灵脉，全身灵脉都在欢呼，他感觉自己的灵脉像干涸的河床突然被灌进了热水，那种又烫又胀的感觉从丹田一路蔓延到四肢百骸，不到半个时辰，体内传来一声轻响。

    咔。

    练气二层初期，练气二层中期。

    “爽。”

    陈青山睁开眼，吐出一口浊气，心中不禁松了一口气，但他很快就冷静下来，太快了，半个月前他还是练气一层，现在练气二层中期，正常废灵根从一层爬到二层少说三五年，他从穿越到现在，算上得鼎前的半年，也就大半年功夫，这速度搁谁身上都扎眼，他想了想，给自己定了个规矩，一个月最多推进一个小阶，再多就是找死。

    操。

    忍住比放开难多了。

    白天陈青山把提纯出的精铁和他用公用熔炉正常熔炼的精铁混在一起交上去，七成普通三成精品掺着来，看起来就是“这批废渣运气好碰上了几块好料”。

    赵铁手翻了翻，点点头。

    “这批精铁不错，杂质比上个月少了。”

    “可能这批废渣本身品质好一些。”陈青山半真半假的说。

    赵铁手没多想，拍了拍他的肩膀，继续巡其他人去了，陈青山暗自松了一口气，心中不禁有些好笑，还行，没露馅。

    但好日子没过几天。

    陈青山的心里也七上八下的，并不怎么踏实，他知道自己的精铁纯度肯定比其他人高出一大截，可是这样能不能过柳青霜这一关，自己心里实在是没底，因此陈青山不由得也把心提到半空中，有点七上八下，忐忑不安。

    这天上午柳青霜来了，她穿着一身器峰执事服饰，手里拿着一块记录板，逐个检查每个杂役本月的产出，面无表情的仔细上下打量着每个人交上来的精铁，其他杂役的精铁她扫一眼就放下，来到陈青山跟前时，她停了，她拿起一块精铁，翻了两下，又拿起一块，然后拿起第三块的时候，她的动作顿住了。

    那是一块暗红色的精铁。

    火精铁。

    混进去了。

    听到这话，陈青山心里微微一沉，他明明已经掺了七成普通精铁进去，没想到还是有一块火精铁漏了出来，颜色和其他精铁差别太明显，他不由得把心提到了嗓子眼，有点七上八下，忐忑不安。
content_en:
In the next few days, Chen Qingshan was busy dealing with the waste residue, sorting during the day and secretly refining at night. His life was fulfilling.

    It has been three days since Liu Qingshuang came to the waste disposal team. As soon as she came, this woman reorganized the rules in the team. Who is responsible for what, how much fine iron should be handed in every day, all clearly written in black and white. Other handymen complained privately, but no one dared to say it to their faces.

    Chen Qingshan didn't care even more. He was concerned about another thing. There was enough food in the waste pile for him to eat for a long time.

    The waste slag in Qifeng is different from that in the waste room. Most of the waste in the waste room is the residue of general waste with limited impurities. The waste in Qifeng contains everything, including broken slag, furnace bottom agglomerates, exploded crucible fragments, and even some gravel soaked in spiritual energy. Normal smelting iron yield is less than 40%, and no one wants to touch it.

    But Good Fortune Cauldron is not picky.

    In this way, Chen Qingshan began his secret cultivation path.

    That night, Chen Qingshan closed the door of the house and secretly collected a piece of dark brown waste from the waste pile. It was the size of a fist and had a lot of impurities. Normally, if ten kilograms of this waste were extracted, three kilograms of refined iron would be produced, which is considered good. , with a thought in his mind, the waste residue was thrown into the cauldron of creation. The flames rose in the cauldron, the waste residue began to melt, and the impurities were peeled off layer by layer. Three hours later, a piece of silver-white fine iron flew out of the cauldron. Chen Qingshan weighed it, and it was more than two taels.

    Ten kilograms of waste residue yields two taels of refined iron. Using normal methods, this is a loss-making business, but what he wants is not quantity, but purity.

    The purity of this piece of refined iron is higher than that usually refined, because this piece of waste contains a small amount of fire poison residue. The Fortune Cauldron also eats the fire poison and turns it into a stronger flame, which is equivalent to earning a wave of fuel in vain.

    "Fire poison is really a good thing..."

    He muttered in a low voice and put in the second piece. Over the night, all fifteen pieces of waste were processed, and he got seven kilograms of refined iron. Then he picked out the best two kilograms and purified them twice. The second purification consumes more spiritual energy. He was running his skills to recover while supplying the cauldron of creation, barely holding on until dawn. The two kilograms of refined iron turned into four taels of iron essence. He did not stop and continued to purify for the third time. This time it took two days, and the four taels of iron essence turned into seven coins of iron essence crystal.

    The crystals the size of rice grains emitted a dazzling silver light, and contained more than twice the essence of vitality that was refined in the waste equipment room last time.

    Chen Qingshan picked up an iron crystal and began to absorb it. The hot energy poured into his spiritual veins, and his whole body's spiritual veins cheered. He felt that his spiritual veins were like a dry river bed that was suddenly filled with hot water. The hot and swollen feeling spread from his dantian to his limbs. In less than half an hour, a soft sound came from his body.

    Click.

    The early stage of the second level of Qi training and the middle stage of the second level of Qi training.

    "It's cool."

    Chen Qingshan opened his eyes, exhaled a breath of turbid air, and couldn't help but feel relieved, but he calmed down very quickly, too quickly. Half a month ago, he was still practicing Qi on the first level, and now he is in the middle of the second level of Qi training. The normal waste spirit root climbed from the first level to the second level. Three to five years have passed since he time traveled to now. Counting the half year before he got the tripod, it was only half a year. This speed would be dazzling to anyone. He thought about it and set a rule for himself. He could advance up to one small step in a month. Any more would be courting death.

    Hold.

    It's much harder to hold back than to let go.

    During the day, Chen Qingshan mixed the refined iron with the refined iron he normally smelted in the public furnace and handed it over. Seventy percent ordinary and three percent fine iron were mixed in. It seemed that "this batch of waste slag was lucky enough to come across a few pieces of good material."

    Zhao Tie turned over his hands and nodded.

    "This batch of refined iron is good, with fewer impurities than last month."

    "Maybe the quality of this batch of waste residue is better." Chen Qingshan said half-truthfully.

    Zhao Tieshou didn't think much, patted him on the shoulder, and continued to patrol the others. Chen Qingshan secretly breathed a sigh of relief, and couldn't help but feel a little funny in his heart. It was okay, no secrets were revealed.

    But the good days lasted only a few days.

    Chen Qingshan was also in a state of anxiety and not very at ease. He knew that the purity of his refined iron must be much higher than others, but he was really unsure whether he could pass Liu Qingshuang's test. Therefore, Chen Qingshan couldn't help but raise his heart in the air, feeling a little uneasy and uneasy.

    Liu Qingshuang came this morning. She was wearing the uniform of a Qifeng deacon, holding a record board in her hand, and checked each handyman's output for the month one by one. She carefully looked up and down the fine iron handed in by each person with an expressionless face. She put down the fine iron of other handymen at a glance. When she came to Chen Qingshan, she stopped. She picked up a piece of fine iron, turned it over twice, picked up another piece, and then paused when she picked up the third piece.

    It was a piece of dark red fine iron.

    Fire essence iron.

    Got in.

    Hearing this, Chen Qingshan's heart sank slightly. He had obviously mixed 70% of ordinary refined iron into it, but he didn't expect that a piece of fire refined iron still leaked out. The color was so different from other refined irons that he couldn't help but feel his heart in his throat, a little nervous and uneasy.
title_en: Chapter 5 Purity 92%? Who are you fooling!
